verdict.rationale: Airwallex's AgentOS lets external AI agents read production account data (balances, transactions) and build cashflow reports through bundled cashflow-management skills, so AI-generated insights on your own data are possible. However, this runs through third-party agent hosts (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Cursor) via MCP, CLI, and plugins, not natively in the Airwallex product. Missing for 10: native in-app AI insights or suggestions inside the Airwallex web app, documentation of what insight or suggestion outputs the skills produce, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
